comment: connect [→ dev-toolbar-admin-btn]  to settings, it should be all a big settings page that admins can see more things and manage more then a dev user
actionLog: Correction: an earlier concurrent run had bookkept this against PR #38, reasoning that DevAdminPanel.jsx's post-#38 Settings hub already gave an admin strictly more than a dev user through the same dev-toolbar-admin-btn. That skipped a step: it never re-checked the actual toolbar JSX in DevAuthGate.jsx. As of this correction, main still has TWO separate buttons — dev-toolbar-admin-btn (opens the fully ADMIN_SECRET-gated DevAdminPanel, blocking even its own Menu tab from a non-admin) and a second, always-visible dev-toolbar-settings-btn (opens a standalone JynxSettings modal, no auth) — exactly what the comment's own wording ("connect [dev-toolbar-admin-btn] to settings") was asking to fix: one entry point, not two. PR #46 removes the standalone settings button/modal and restructures DevAdminPanel.jsx so its Menu tab renders for any dev user unauthenticated, while Dev Users/Logs stay behind the ADMIN_SECRET gate — verified directly against the current dev-toolbar-admin-btn/dev-toolbar-settings-btn markup before implementing, not just by reading PR #38's description.
